system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

You learn to make different medicines that can heal or enhance combat capabilities or infuse into jutsu or, known as Hanami Boons/Banes. When you complete a short or long rest, you can select Boons or Banes each with a single use. You can create a number of Boons or Banes equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can prepare multiple copies of the same Boon or Bane. You can give a Boon to a willing creature at no action cost on the consuming creature turn, or on your turn, so long as they are within 5 feet of you. They must still consume it. Consuming a Boon costs 1 Bonus action. Banes have their infusion requirements listed in their text and use your highest jutsu save DC if it calls for a saving throw. Any unused Boons or Banes become inert, losing their potency when you complete a short or long rest.

A creature can only benefit from one Boon at a time. Consuming a Boon while benefiting from one, causing the oldest Boons effects to be dispelled.

Beginning at 7th level, you can make Fused Boons/Banes. When you do, select two different Boons or Banes. Fused Boons/Banes impart the benefit of both chosen Boons or Banes. Only you can consume a Fused Boon.

Beginning at 11th level, you no longer need to spend a Bonus action to consume a Boon and you can administer Boons to allied creatures at no action, on your turn as well.

Blessed Boon

By consuming this Boon, the affected creature becomes blessed with vitality that it never had before. It gains a +1d4 bonus to their attacks, checks and saving throws, until the end of its next turn.

Boosting Boon

By consuming this Boon, the affected creature gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range for melee attacks for the next minute. This increases to +2 at 11th level. If it scores a critical hit with an unarmed attack, add +1d12 to the damage dealt. This increases to 2d12 at 7th level.

Combo/Finisher Boon

By consuming this Boon, for the next minute when the affected creature casts Jutsu with the Medical or Inhale keyword, those jutsu gain the Combo keyword, as if they were a Taijutsu.

Alternatively, when the affected creature casts a Jutsu with the Combo keyword, if the next jutsu they cast has the Medical or Inhale keyword, it also gains the Finisher keyword, and increases the damage dealt by +2 damage die.

Lucky Boon

By consuming this Boon, the affected creatures next d20 roll before the beginning of their next turn, treats any roll below a 10, as a 10.

Restoring Boon

By consuming this Boon, the affected creature rolls two of its Hit Die and adds its constitution modifier to the result, regaining hit points equal to the results. This increases to three hit die at 7th and four hit die at 15th level.

Swift Boon

By consuming this Boon, the affected creature gains a +10 bonus to its movement speed and can ignore difficult terrain for the next minute. This increases to a +15 bonus to speed at 7th level and +20 at 15th level.

Warding Boon

By consuming this Boon, the affected creature gains resistance to one damage type of its choice, for 1 minute. This becomes two damage types of its choice at 11th level.

Dispelling Bane

As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save has one jutsu they are currently concentrating on of the same rank or lower dispelled.

Dispirited Bane

As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, becomes Confused for the next minute. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Fragile Bane

As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane. On a failed save, for the next minute, the Bruised condition gains the Max Ranks: 5 tag, allow it to be applied up to 5 times. A creature with more than 1 rank of Bruised increases the bonus damage they take by +4, for each rank they have beyond the first.

Hindering Bane

As part of casting a jutsu with the Medical or Inhaled keyword that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, you can select either Strength, Intelligence or Wisdom. For the next minute, the affected creature gains a d4 penalty to attacks or saves with the chosen ability. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Sluggish Bane

As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, becomes Slow. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Weakening Bane

As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save gains one rank of Weakened for the next minute. At the end of the affected creatures turn, they make a Constitution saving throw, on a failure, they gain an additional rank of Weakened for the duration. If they succeed this save three times, they end this effect and remove all ranks of Weakened gained by this bane.

Gambling Bane

As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save rolls a d6. On a roll of 1, they lose their next action. On a roll of 2-4, they lose their bonus action. On a roll of 5 or 6, they suffer no effect.
